title: Reverse Integer
code:
Start with the numbers 123, -123, 120, and 1534236469.
For each value in numbers.
Let sign be 1.
Let magnitude be value.
If magnitude is less than 0, set sign to -1, set magnitude to 0 minus magnitude.
Let reversed be 0.
Repeat while magnitude is more than 0, set digit to magnitude modulo 10, set reversed to reversed times 10 plus digit, set magnitude to magnitude divided by 10.
If reversed is more than 2147483647, print 0, otherwise print reversed times sign.

title: String to Integer (atoi)
code:
Let word be "   -42".
Let final be one less than the number of characters in word.
Let position be 0.
Let value be 0.
Let sign be 1.
Repeat while position is at most final and character position of word is 32.
Add 1 to position.

If position is at most final and character position of word is 45, set sign to -1, add 1 to position.
If position is at most final and character position of word is 43, add 1 to position.
Repeat while position is at most final and character position of word is at least 48 and character position of word is at most 57.
Set value to value times 10 plus character position of word minus 48.
Add 1 to position.

If sign is -1, set value to 0 minus value.
If value is more than 2147483647, set value to 2147483647.
If value is less than -2147483648, set value to -2147483648.
Print value.

title: Container With Most Water
code:

Let best area be 0.
For every first from 0 to the last position of heights.
For every second from one more than first to the last position of heights.
Let width be second minus first.
Let low height be the smaller of item first of heights and item second of heights.
Let area be the product of width and low height.
If area is greater than best area, set best area to area.

Print best area.

code:
Let value be 1994.
Let result be empty text.
Repeat while value is at least 1000, append "M" to result, set value to value minus 1000.
If value is at least 900, append "CM" to result, set value to value minus 900.
If value is at least 500, append "D" to result, set value to value minus 500.
If value is at least 400, append "CD" to result, set value to value minus 400.
Repeat while value is at least 100, append "C" to result, set value to value minus 100.
If value is at least 90, append "XC" to result, set value to value minus 90.
If value is at least 50, append "L" to result, set value to value minus 50.
If value is at least 40, append "XL" to result, set value to value minus 40.
Repeat while value is at least 10, append "X" to result, set value to value minus 10.
If value is at least 9, append "IX" to result, set value to value minus 9.
If value is at least 5, append "V" to result, set value to value minus 5.
If value is at least 4, append "IV" to result, set value to value minus 4.
Repeat while value is at least 1, append "I" to result, set value to value minus 1.
Print result.

title: Roman to Integer
code:
Let word be "MCMXCIV".
Let final be one less than the number of characters in word.
Let total be 0.
For every position from 0 to final.
Let current be 0.
Let following be 0.
Let symbol be character position of word.
If symbol is 77, set current to 1000.
If symbol is 68, set current to 500.
If symbol is 67, set current to 100.
If symbol is 76, set current to 50.
If symbol is 88, set current to 10.
If symbol is 86, set current to 5.
If symbol is 73, set current to 1.
Let next position be one more than position.
If position is less than final, set following to character next position of word.
If following is 77, set following to 1000.
If following is 68, set following to 500.
If following is 67, set following to 100.
If following is 76, set following to 50.
If following is 88, set following to 10.
If following is 86, set following to 5.
If following is 73, set following to 1.
If current is less than following, set total to total minus current, otherwise set total to total plus current.

Print total.

title: Trapping Rain Water
code:
Let heights be a list of 0, 1, 0, 2, 1, 0, 1, 3, 2, 1, 2, and 1.
Let water be 0.
For every position from 0 to the last position of heights.
Let current be item position of heights.
Let left highest be 0.
For every earlier from 0 to position, if item earlier of heights is greater than left highest, set left highest to item earlier of heights.
Let right highest be 0.
For every later from position to the last position of heights, if item later of heights is greater than right highest, set right highest to item later of heights.
Let boundary be the smaller of left highest and right highest.
Let depth be boundary minus current.
If depth is more than 0, add depth to water.

Print water.

title: Pow(x, n)
code:
Let result be 1.0.
Let factor be 2.0.
Let power be 10.
Repeat while power is more than 0.
If power modulo 2 is 1, set result to result times factor.
Set factor to factor times factor.
Set power to power divided by 2.

Print result.
